profiles.quote: Every day felt kinder with you beside us.
profiles.story: Milo greeted us at the door with his favorite toy. We remember our long walks, his wet nose and the quiet sound of him sleeping beside the sofa.
profiles.favorite: Walks by the lake, a ball and naps beside the family.

profiles.quote: Our little patch of sunshine at home.
profiles.story: Luna always found the sunniest spot by the window. In the evenings she settled beside our books and filled the room with gentle purring.
profiles.favorite: Sunny windowsills, paper bags and a soft blanket.

profiles.quote: Every walk brings back a memory of you.
profiles.story: Richie loved discovering new paths and always looked back to check we were close. Even a short walk became an adventure with him.
profiles.favorite: Woodland trails, autumn leaves and playing with sticks.

profiles.quote: Your gentle purr stays with us.
profiles.story: Bella arrived on a quiet autumn evening. Before long she had claimed the cozy armchair and become our companion through every household task.
profiles.favorite: Her armchair, ribbons and watching birds.

profiles.quote: So much joy in one wagging tail.
profiles.story: Charlie could make us smile with a single look. He loved visitors and was always the first to greet anyone coming home.
profiles.favorite: Meadow games, country trips and meeting friends.

profiles.quote: Thank you for the quiet happiness of being close.
profiles.story: Busya always found a spot beside us. We cherish memories of her soft paws and her habit of napping on the edge of our desk.
profiles.favorite: Boxes, warm blankets and quiet evenings together.

profiles.quote: Our faithful friend on every road.
profiles.story: Oscar joined us on trips and walks. He especially loved stopping by the water, where we could watch the distance and rest together.
profiles.favorite: Road trips, walks by the water and his soft toy.

profiles.quote: You brought so much light into our home.
profiles.story: Nika explored every corner and found new places to sleep. Her curiosity made ordinary days a little brighter.
profiles.favorite: Rustling toys, high shelves and morning sunshine.

meta.title: PetMemoreal — a place for lasting memories
meta.description: A quiet online garden in memory of beloved pets. Stories, small gestures of love, and a place to return to in your own time.

hero.label: A garden in memory of beloved pets
hero.title: Love stays.
hero.description: Keep your pet’s story in a quiet garden and return to the memories you treasure.

hero.artCaption: A small place. A great love.

about.label: More than a name and dates
about.title:
Their little habits.
Your favourite paths.
A whole life together.
about.description: How they greeted you at the door. Where they loved to sleep. The walks that made you happy. Little moments tell the bigger story of your friendship.
about.detail: Here, that story has a place you can return to.

how.label: Your place in the garden
how.title: Keep what matters, one step at a time.

items.title: Find your quiet corner
items.description: Choose a garden and a free spot on the map. Beside the water, among flowers or in the shade — wherever feels right.

items.title: Tell your friend’s story
items.description: Add a name, years of life and a story. A tender moment, a funny habit or just a few words that matter.

items.title: Return to your memories
items.description: Visit your memorial from your account. Share its link with the people who remember your friend too.

values.label: No hurry. No expectations.
values.title: Everyone remembers in their own way.

items.title: A place for every pet
items.description: Creating a memorial is free, for any beloved pet who became part of your life.

items.title: At your own pace
items.description: Visit every day or after a long time away. Your friend’s story will be there when you return.

items.title: With the people you love
items.description: Share a link with those who cared for your pet. They can read the story without an account.

items.question: How do I create a memorial?
items.answer: Sign in, choose a garden and select a free spot marked with a “+”. Add your pet’s name, years of life and story. Once saved, the memorial appears in the garden and in your account.

items.question: What if I don’t visit for a while?
items.answer: Your place and story will stay. Come back whenever you wish — there are no visits to keep up with.

items.question: Who can read my pet’s story?
items.answer: Stories in the garden are open to all visitors. Share only what you feel comfortable keeping in this shared space of remembrance.

items.question: How can I invite friends and family?
items.answer: Open the memorial and copy the link from your address bar. It leads straight to your pet’s story. No account is needed to read it.

footer.line: For little lives that leave a lasting mark.
